text.tspan: C4-E38 · Original cohesive work and fracture criteria
Γ = ∫₀^δ_c tₙ dδ = ½ Tₘₐₓ δ_c
Initiation: peak traction Tₘₐₓ must be reached.
Separation: the area Γ must be supplied over the full opening δ_c.
Both must refer to the interface that actually fails.
Defence 3: release succeeds only if both initiation and separation work are provided at the correct interface.
Reference formulas of the Defence 3 answer: Eqs. C4-E11, E25, E26.
